title: The 5 AM Club Learns the 20/20/20 Formula
coreMove: The 20/20/20 Formula converts 5:00 to 6:00 AM into whole-person training through movement, reflection, and growth.

exampleSpecs.audience: people starting too foggy for reflection
exampleSpecs.stakes: reflection can stay dull when the body has not been activated
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use movement first to support clearer thought

exampleSpecs.stakes: movement without reflection can leave direction unclear
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the second block for journaling, prayer, planning, or quiet thought

exampleSpecs.stakes: unplanned growth time can be stolen by low-value input
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use final 20 minutes for reading, study, or skill development

exampleSpecs.audience: people overusing one part of the hour
exampleSpecs.stakes: single-domain routines can leave the person underprepared
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Connect the formula to four interior empires

exampleSpecs.audience: students waking early without measurable renewal
exampleSpecs.stakes: vague early time can feel virtuous while producing little change
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Treat 5:00 to 6:00 as a compact training block
